description:
The shared vocabulary of the agents area, package ai.mindconnect.agent:
        Namespace (the tenant), NamespacedId (the shape every tenant-owned id
        has), UserId and AuthenticationInfo. A type belongs here only when two
        modules that do not depend on each other need it; every other id lives
        beside its entity. Dependency-free — every other agents module builds
        on it, nothing outside the area knows it.
